candidates.benefit: From 23 – 26 September, when you order our Say Cheese (Burger) Bundle, we’ll treat you to a complimentary ShackBurger(Single). That’s right—more Angus beef, more flavor, all in one bundle.
candidates.description:
100% Angus Beef – Just for You
At Shake Shack, we don’t cut corners—especially when it comes to our beef. That’s why our burgers start with 100% Angus beef, freshly ground and packed with flavor. And this September, we’re giving you even more reasons to sink your teeth into it.
Here’s the Deal
From 23 – 26 September, when you order our Say Cheese (Burger) Bundle, we’ll treat you to a complimentary ShackBurger(Single). That’s right—more Angus beef, more flavor, all in one bundle.
Here’s what’s in the bundle (From $28.90):
● Choice of 1 Burger
● Complimentary ShackBurger (Single)
● Choice of Fries
● Choice of Bites
● Choice of 2 Drinks
Don’t Miss Out
This offer is available 23 – 26 September across all Shacks and Happy Point Singapore in-app orders. Come hungry, bring a friend, and taste the difference that 100% Angus beef makes.
Terms and Conditions
Offer is available across all Shake Shack outlets in Singapore from 23-26 September 2025 only. Offer is valid for dine-in and take-away. The offer is valid in the Shack and Happy Point Singapore in-app orders. Offer not valid for orders made through third-party delivery apps. Offer is not valid in conjunction with any other vouchers. Offer is non-refundable, non-extendable, non-exchangeable for cash or for any other menu items. Shake Shack Singapore reserves the right to vary and amend these terms and conditions at any time without prior notice. Visuals are for illustration purposes only.

candidates.title: All About Chickens
candidates.description:
At Shake Shack, we’re all about doing things the right way—and that includes our chicken.
We’re celebrating the kind that’s raised with care, not cages. Our 100% cage-free chicken isn’t
just good, it’s part of our promise to support better animal welfare and a more responsible
food system. Because when your chicken’s raised right, you can taste the difference—and feel
good about it too.
Here’s what’s in the bundle (From $30.80):
Choice of 1 Burger
Complimentary Chicken Shack
Choice of Fries
Choice of Bites
Choice of 2 Drinks

candidates.title: Feeding a Crowd?
candidates.description:
There’s something about sharing a meal that makes any occasion a little better. With Shake
Shack Catering, order 10 of your favorite items and enjoy another 2 on us!
Whether it’s a team lunch, a birthday celebration, a casual get-together with family or simply
an excuse to gather around the table, good food has a way of bringing people together. And
with a little extra to share, there’s more for everyone to enjoy.
So gather the team, round up your friends or bring the whole family. Simply submit a catering
request with us here and we’ll take care of the rest!
*Terms & Conditions:
● Promotion entitles guests to purchase 12 items for the price of 10.
● Promotion is applicable to selected items of the same price and is subject to item availability.
● Catering requests are subject to confirmation. A minimum of 72 hours’ advance notice is recommended.
● Promotion is valid for pickup orders only. Complimentary delivery is available for orders above $500.
● Promotion cannot be used in conjunction with other promotions or discounts.
● Shake Shack Singapore reserves the right to amend or withdraw the promotion at any time without prior notice.

candidates.title: Hello, Parkway Parade!
candidates.description:
Hello, Parkway Parade!
Fellow Easties, your new neighbourhood Shack has arrived! Our 12th Shack is now officially open at Parkway Parade, bringing in our burgers, crinkle cut fries, shakes and all the Shack favorites to the heart of the neighbourhood
Whether you’re an Eastie or just making your way over, we’ve got a new spot for you to grab a bite, catch up with friends and settle into some good Shack time.
A Little Taste of the Coast
A stone’s throw from the beach, this new Shack brings a little taste of the neighbourhood’s coastal spirit indoors. From rippling details inspired by the tide to warm timber and natural textures, spot the details that bring pieces of the shore into the space!
Come Celebrate With Us
Enjoy a little opening treat on us! From 11 September to 10 October, enjoy 10% OFF* with a minimum spend of $16 when you use promo code: PPOPENING.
See you at Parkway Parade Shack!
*Terms and conditions apply: Promo code is valid from 11 September to 10 October 2026. Promo code is applicable with minimum $16 purchase and is redeemable exclusively via the Happy Point Singapore app; the promo code is not valid on third-party delivery platforms. Redemption is valid at Parkway Parade Shake Shack Singapore outlet and is limited to one use per order. This promotion cannot be combined with any other offers or promotions. Shake Shack Singapore is not responsible for lost, stolen, expired, or misused codes, and reserves the right to amend or end the promotion without prior notice.

candidates.title: National Cheeseburger Day
candidates.description:
National Cheeseburger Day
If there’s one day on the calendar that feels made for us, it’s the National Cheeseburger Day. Afterall, we’ve been putting our spin on the great American cheeseburger since 2004 with the ShackBurger
And what’s a better way to celebrate than with extra beef? From 14 – 18 September, celebrate National CheeseBurger day with a FREE Beef Patty add-on* with any ShackBurger or SmokeShack purchase via the Happy Point app.
The Cheeseburger Formula
The cheeseburger has earned its place as an American classic with a simple formula: beef, cheese, bun and toppings. But when something is made up of just a few ingredients, every one of them matters. So, what makes a great cheeseburger? Let’s break down the basics.
Real Beef
For us, a good cheeseburger starts with the beef. That’s why our beef patties are made to order with 100% Angus beef. Each quarter-pound beef patty is smashed to order, seasoned, seared and cheesed to bring together the rich, beefy flavor and juicy texture that fans know and love.
Real Classic
We believe in keeping good things simple. So when it came to our version of the great American cheeseburger, reinvention wasn’t really on the agenda. Getting it right was.
While it sounds simple, getting simple right actually took years of tinkering, tweaking and plenty of tasting before we landed on the ShackBurger, a classic in its own right that continues to let the beef speak for itself.
Now that you know the beef, come taste it for yourself!
How to redeem:
Tap on ‘Order’
Select a ShackBurger / SmokeShack
Select Double – the second patty’s automatically on us! (Or go triple with a little top-up if you’re going all in)
Check out and enjoy!
*Terms and conditions: Promotion is valid from 14 to 18 September 2026, while stocks last. Promotion is available exclusively through the Happy Point Singapore app and is not valid on third-party delivery platforms. Promotion is valid for ShackBurger and SmokeShack only, with a second beef patty included at no additional charge. Top-up charges apply to any additional beef patties beyond two, as well as selected modifiers. Valid at all Shake Shack Singapore outlets. Shake Shack Singapore reserves the right to amend or terminate the promotion without prior notice.

Yes, it’s true – Shack Meals have arrived and your weekday lunches just got an upgrade.
The Shack Meal is your go-to for when you want something solid without overthinking it – your choice of burger, side and a drink starting from $15.10, only on Happy Point.
It’s available weekdays from 11am to 2pm (excluding PH), so whether you’re sneaking in a quick bite or just unwinding, we’ve got you.
Order now and try your own Shack Meal on the Happy Point app, the perfect way to level up your Shack order.

Singlish Lingo
Hey Shack Fans! We’ve got something exciting just for you. From 11th to 15th November, we’re spicing things up at all our Shacks with a local twist on our Zi Char menu. To celebrate Singapore’s vibrant food culture, we’re inviting you to place your orders with a sprinkle of Singlish flair!
Here’s how it works: order any of our Zi Char burgers using one of the selected Singlish words, and you’ll get a complimentary Buah Long Long Lemonade on the house! Yup, you heard us right—shiok, right?
How to Join the Fun?
Swing by your nearest Shack, choose your favorite Zi Char burger, and use one of these
Singlish words:
Dabao – Because sometimes you just need to take that goodness away.
Zi Char – A nod to our hawker culture and the heart of communal dining.
Makan – To enjoy a meal together or dig in!
Why are we doing this leh?
At Shake Shack, we’re all about great food and even better conversations. This time, we want
to celebrate local culture in a way that’s uniquely Singaporean. It’s our way of saying thank you to the community that’s made us feel so at home here.
So, mark your calendars, jio your friends, and come on down to any Shack between 11th to 15th November. Let’s makan and enjoy some good vibes together! We’ll see you soon!
Terms and conditions:
This offer is valid from 11th to 15th November 2024 at all Shake Shack outlets in Singapore.
Guests must use one of the accepted Singlish words (“Shiok,” “Dabao,” “Zi Char,” or “Makan”)
when ordering any Zi Char burger to qualify for the promotion.
Each qualifying order will receive one (1) complimentary Buah Long Long Lemonade.
Offer is limited to one (1) complimentary Buah Long Long Lemonade per guest per visit, regardless of the number of burgers ordered.
This promotion is valid for both dine-in and takeaway orders. Not applicable for delivery orders.
Complimentary beverages are not transferable, redeemable for cash, or exchangeable for any
other items.
Promotion is valid while stocks last. Shake Shack reserves the right to replace the
complimentary beverage with a similar item of equal value in the event of unforeseen
circumstances.
Shake Shack reserves the right to modify or cancel the promotion at any time without prior
notice.
In the event of any disputes, Shake Shack’s decision will be fina

candidates.title: Study Breaks Just Got Better
candidates.description:
Good news, students! Your next study break comes with a little treat on us. Whether you’re catching up with friends after class or grabbing a quick bite before your next lesson, everything’s just a little better with crinkle cuts.
On weekdays, enjoy Crinkle Cut Fries on us* with any burger and drink purchase. Simply present a valid student ID at the cashier. This offer is available exclusively at our Westgate, Junction 8 or Great World locations.
See you at the Shack!
*Terms and conditions: Promotion is available on weekdays (excluding Public Holidays) at Westgate, Junction 8 and Great World Shack locations only. A valid student ID must be presented at the point of purchase to enjoy the promotion. The offer is open to all primary, secondary, tertiary and university students in Singapore. Shake Shack Singapore reserves the right to amend or end the promotion without prior notice.

candidates.title: This One’s For Your Mom
candidates.description:
This year, skip the flower bouquets and go straight for the burgers. On May 11, we’re serving up a Mother’s Day Bundle that’s stacked with everything she loves—because nothing says “I appreciate you” like burgers, bites, and a little extra on the house.
Here’s what’s in the bundle (From $30.80):
Choice of 1 Burger
Complimentary ShackBurger or Chicken Shack
Choice of Fries
Choice of Bites
Choice of 2 Drinks
It’s stacked, it’s sharable, and it’s made with 100% Angus beef and premium ingredients.
TERMS & CONDITIONS:
•⁠ ⁠Offer is available across all Shake Shack outlets in Singapore on 11 May only.
•⁠ ⁠Offer is valid for dine-in only.
•⁠ ⁠Offer not valid for orders made through third-party delivery apps.
•⁠ ⁠Limited to 1 order per person and transaction.
•⁠ ⁠Offer is not valid in conjunction with any other vouchers.
•⁠ ⁠Offer is non-refundable, non-extendable, non-exchangeable for cash or for any other menu items.
•⁠ ⁠Shake Shack Singapore reserves the right to vary and amend these terms and conditions at any time without prior notice.
•⁠ ⁠Visuals are for illustration purposes only.

candidates.title: We’re introducing Chicken Sundays!
candidates.description:
Here at Shake Shack, we pride ourselves on our Chicken Shack which is available 7 days a
week. With crispy, white-meat chicken breast or thigh over lettuce, pickles and buttermilk
herb mayo on a toasted potato bun, this sandwich outshines its competition. And what
makes our Chicken Shack even better, is that it’s made with 100% cage-free chickens,
something not everyone can say these days…
Every Sunday from 30 November to 28 December, we are offering a Free Chicken Shack with any chicken sandwich purchase with promo code: CHICKENSUNDAY. Just order on our Happy Point Singapore app to taste the true difference.
Download the App: https://app.happypointcard.com.sg/
Terms and Conditions
Offer is available across all Shake Shack outlets in Singapore every Sunday from 30
November to 28 December 2025 only. Offer applies with any chicken sandwich purchase.
Offer is valid for dine-in and take-away. The offer is only valid via Happy Point Singapore
in-app orders. Offer not valid for orders made through third-party delivery apps. Offer is not
valid in conjunction with any other vouchers. Offer is non-refundable, non-extendable,
non-exchangeable for cash or for any other menu items. Shake Shack Singapore reserves the
right to vary and amend these terms and conditions at any time without prior notice. Visuals
are for illustration purposes only.
